intro:
For companies that want an operations-ready building, designed around their process,
 with the option to buy or lease it.
description: We design and build your facility from 196,068 to 779,163 ft² (18,215 to 72,387 m²), with the infrastructure, loading docks and layout defined by your operation. 8 configurations approved for construction.

buy.title: IF YOU BUY
buy.text:
You turn the building into equity: full control over
 an asset on Northeast Mexico's main logistics corridor.

lease.title: IF YOU LEASE
lease.text: You occupy the building without tying up capital: your money stays where it performs best —in machinery, inventory and people. Fast start-up and room to grow.

feature1.title: TAILORED TO YOU
feature1.text: Clear height, docks, ramps, offices, power and layout defined around your process.

feature2.title: SCHEDULED DELIVERY
feature2.text:
Clear dates from contract signing.
 Your start-up plan doesn't depend on promises.

feature3.title: INSTITUTIONAL TERMS
feature3.text: USD-denominated contracts, designed for long-term operations

feature4.title: PLANNED GROWTH
feature4.text: Buildings prepared for expansion within the same park.

sizes.title: AVAILABLE SIZES
sizes.note:
Building gross floor area. Configurations per architectural drawings, July 2026.
Small buildings can be combined; a single building can occupy the entire park.

items.label: STRUCTURE
items.value: Tilt-up or precast concrete walls, steel structure with trusses and KR-18 roof deck
